name: NVIDIA

Software Engineer (entry–mid).dsaDepth: Moderate — online coding test (LeetCode medium–hard) for early-career roles, then a decentralized, hiring-manager-driven loop
rounds: Recruiter call (~30 min, often skippable if referred)
Online assessment (timed, proctored, often HackerRank; mainly for early-career roles)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, live coding: e.g. reverse a linked list recursively/non-recursively)
Optional hiring-manager call (~30 min) — order varies a lot, sometimes held before other rounds
Onsite loop (~5 hrs): several technical interviews plus a domain deep-dive and often a system design round
extraTopics: Domain depth — the loop is shaped heavily by the specific team and hiring manager, more so than most large tech companies
Being ready for the loop order to vary (one candidate had the hiring-manager call first)

Senior Software Engineer (IC4).dsaDepth: Moderate — similar structure with more system design and architecture weight
rounds: Similar stages, with a heavier system design round and deeper technical-experience discussion
extraTopics: System design for the specific hardware/software domain
